title: 약 봉투 읽기: 언제, 몇 번, 몇 알 먹어요?

review: Section '약 봉투 A' paragraph 1: the fields run together with no separators ('…2026년 9월 24일 복용법: 1일 3회, 1회 1포, 식후 30분 3일분 주의: …'), while Envelopes B and C use '|'. '식후 30분 3일분' looks like one phrase, and beginners could misread it. Exercises 1, 2 and 6 depend on reading this envelope. Add separators to match B and C: '이름: 마리아 님 | 조제일: 2026년 9월 24일 | 복용법: 1일 3회, 1회 1포, 식후 30분 | 3일분 | 주의: 졸음이 올 수 있어요. 운전 주의.' Putting each field on its own line also works.

fixes.before: HOW MANY TIMES A DAY — 1일 3회 (il-il sam-hoe) = 3 times a day. 일 means 'day' and 회 means 'time(s)'. People say this as 하루 세 번.
fixes.after: HOW MANY TIMES A DAY — 1일 3회 (iril samhoe) = 3 times a day. 일 means 'day' and 회 means 'time(s)'. People say this as 하루 세 번.

fixes.problem: 'Membacanya dengan suara' is unnatural and incomplete Indonesian for 'reading it aloud'; the standard expression is 'dengan suara keras'.
fixes.fix: 소리 내어 읽기 (MEMBACANYA DENGAN SUARA KERAS)

fixes.problem: "Beginner (high)" means the upper part of the beginner level. 上級 means "advanced," so 初級(上級) gives a confusing level label.
"高级" means "advanced level", so "初级（高级）" reads as "Beginner (Advanced)". The English means the upper part of the beginner level.

manual.before: A practical reading sheet on the Korean pharmacy medicine envelope (약 봉투). Learners read three short envelope labels. They learn the dosage words that appear on almost every envelope (1일 3회, 1회 1포, 식후 30분, 취침 전, 3일분) and how to say them aloud with native Korean counters (하루 세 번, 한 알). They also learn two common warnings: 졸음이 올 수 있어요 and 운전 주의.
manual.after: Read three short medicine envelope (약 봉투) labels. Learn the dosage words on almost every envelope (1일 3회, 1회 1포, 식후 30분, 취침 전, 3일분), how to say them aloud (하루 세 번, 한 알), and two common warnings.
manual.why: A translation ran onto a third page: summary/objective tightened and repeated lines merged so every language fits two pages without squeezing.

manual.before: After reading a pharmacy medicine envelope, learners can find four things: how many times a day to take the medicine, when to take it (식전 / 식후 30분 / 취침 전), how much to take each time (1포, 1알/1정), and for how many days (○일분). They can also recognize the warnings 졸음이 올 수 있어요 and 운전 주의.
manual.after: Learners can find how many times a day, when (식전 / 식후 30분 / 취침 전), how much (1포, 1알/1정) and for how many days (○일분) to take a medicine, and recognize the warnings 졸음이 올 수 있어요 and 운전 주의.
